{{Quote|The Rebels have really gone all out for this Wookiee holiday. I got a peek at the rewards and there were some interesting items to be had at the two vendors located in each city. Some of the items I got the chance to see were a Wroshyr Tree House Decoration, a Holo-Entertainment Table, Itchy's Proton Chair, and my personal favorite, a Kowakian monkey lizard house pet.|Hol't Deb Orah|<ref name="Corellia Tiems">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68147&month=122008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; ''Corellia Times'' Exclusive: Life Day Revealed}}</ref>}}
'''Hol't Deb Orah''' was a reporter who worked for the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was sent by them to report on [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. He also attempted to learn from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] his views on the holiday, but he ended up getting his publicist instead, who stated that, although Palpatine wasn't going to acknowledge the efforts of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Palpatine would nonetheless issue an official "Bah, humbug!" for those who were celebrating.
